questions.question: If 9x + 4 = 67, what is the value of 90x + 40?
questions.explanation: Subtracting 4 gives 9x = 63, so x = 7, and 90x + 40 = 630 + 40 = 670. (Or note 90x + 40 = 10(9x + 4) = 10 × 67.)

questions.question: The equation d = 33w + 100 gives the total amount of money d, in dollars, that James plans to save w weeks after he starts to save. What is the total amount of money, in dollars, he plans to save in 10 weeks?

A salesperson earns 2 points for each call made to a potential customer and 6 points for each visit made to a potential customer. Last week, the salesperson earned a total of 366 points. The equation 2x + 6y = 366 represents this situation. Which is the best interpretation of 6y in this context?
options: The number of calls the salesperson made to potential customers last week
The number of visits the salesperson made to potential customers last week
The total number of points the salesperson earned from calls made to potential customers last week
The total number of points the salesperson earned from visits made to potential customers last week
questions.explanation: y is the number of visits and each visit earns 6 points, so 6y is the points earned from visits.

questions.question: The function j is defined by j(x) = (10x + 5)/(3p), and the function k is defined by k(x) = (j(x) · p)/(x + 1), where p is a positive constant. What is the value of k(9)?
The population of a certain city doubled every 25 years from 1660 to 1760. The population of this city was 208,000 in 1760. What was the population of this city in 1660?
questions.explanation: From 1660 to 1760 is 100 years, or 4 doublings, so the 1660 population was 208,000 / 2^4 = 13,000.

questions.question: When several resistors are connected in series in a circuit, the total resistance of the circuit is the sum of the resistances of these resistors. A certain circuit consists of 8 resistors connected in series, where the resistance of each resistor is positive. This circuit has a total resistance of 130 ohms. The total resistance of 3 resistors in this circuit is 90 ohms. Which inequality best represents all possible values of the resistance x, in ohms, of one of the other 5 resistors in this circuit?

questions.question: Which expression represents the product of (x<sup>−9</sup>y<sup>8z</sup><sup>4</sup>) and (x<sup>5z</sup><sup>4</sup> + y<sup>3z</sup><sup>−7</sup>)?
questions.explanation: Distribute and add exponents of like bases: x^(−9)y^8z^4 · x^5z^4 = x^(−4)y^8z^8 and x^(−9)y^8z^4 · y^3z^(−7) = x^(−9)y^11z^(−3).

The graph gives the estimated revenue, in dollars, for a company when the price of the company's product is x dollars. What does the y-value of the vertex of the graph represent in this context?
options: The price, in dollars, of the company's product
The minimum estimated revenue, in dollars
The maximum estimated revenue, in dollars
The estimated revenue, in dollars, when the price of the company's product is 0 dollars
questions.explanation: The vertex is the highest point of the parabola, so its y-value is the maximum estimated revenue.

questions.question: In the xy-plane above, the graph of a quadratic function y = f(x) intersects the x-axis at points O and Q, and has a vertex at point P. If line ℓ passes through points P and Q, what is the y-intercept of line ℓ?

The function f gives the value, in dollars, of a certain piece of equipment after x months of use. If the value of the equipment decreases each year by p% of its value the preceding year, what is the value of p?
questions.explanation: Every 12 months the value is multiplied by 0.28, so it keeps 28% and loses 72% each year.

questions.question: A marine biologist is studying a habitat that contains shoal bass, a species of freshwater fish. The box plot shown summarizes the lengths, in centimeters (cm), of a sample of 70 shoal bass from this habitat. What is the range, in cm, of the lengths of the shoal bass in the sample?
questions.explanation: The minimum is 34 cm and the maximum is 49 cm, so the range is 49 − 34 = 15.

If x+53 = x+513, the value of x + 5 is between which of the following pairs of values?
questions.explanation: Only x + 5 = 0 satisfies the equation (the denominators differ), and 0 lies between −4 and 4.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = |x − 6x|. What value of a satisfies f(7) − f(a) = −15?
questions.explanation: f(x) = |−5x| = 5|x|, so f(7) = 35 and f(a) = 50, giving |a| = 10. Only 10 is offered.

questions.explanation: Distribute the 9: 9(x^2 + 6) = 9x^2 + 54.

questions.question:
x2 − 2x − 18 = 0
One solution to the given equation can be written as 1 + √k, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Complete the square: (x − 1)^2 = 19, so x = 1 ± √19 and k = 19.

questions.question:
x2 − 84x − 14 = 0
What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: The sum of the solutions of x^2 + bx + c = 0 is −b, so the sum is 84.

questions.question:
y = 5(x − 2)2
y = 10(x − 2)
A solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is one possible value of x + y?
questions.explanation: Setting 5(x − 2)² = 10(x − 2) gives x = 2 or x = 4. For x = 4, y = 20 and x + y = 24 (x = 2 gives 2, which is not offered).

The equation gives the estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of every six-month period, x, starting from the end of January 1992, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 4. Which statement is the best interpretation of the y-intercept of the graph of this equation in the xy-plane?
options: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of the first six-month period was 500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1992 was 500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1993 was 1,500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1992 was 1,500.
questions.explanation: At x = 0, y = 500(3)^0 = 500, the count at the end of January 1992.

questions.question:
x + 5 = 11
y = 3x2 + 3
At what point (x, y) do the graphs of the equations in the given system intersect?
questions.explanation: x = 6, then y = 3(36) + 3 = 111, so the point is (6, 111).

questions.question: There are a total of 340 seats in a school auditorium. During an assembly, students occupied 50% of the seats in the auditorium. How many seats did the students occupy during this assembly?

On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,255 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,956. The equation 10x + 26,255 = 26,956 describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?
options: The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010
The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010
questions.explanation: x is added 10 times (once per year over 10 years) to the starting population, so x is the yearly increase.

questions.question: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 493 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a rate of 0.9 pound per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation did the black bear weigh 430 pounds?

The composition of an animal is defined as the muscles, bones, and fat of the animal. A scientist studied the composition of one young swamp buffalo and determined the buffalo had 133 kilograms of muscle, which made up approximately 65.9% of its composition. Of the remaining composition of this buffalo, approximately 46.2% was bone, and the remainder was fat. Based on these approximations, to the nearest tenth, how many kilograms of this buffalo's composition was bone?
questions.explanation: Total: 133 ÷ 0.659 ≈ 201.8 kg. Remaining: about 68.8 kg. Bone: 0.462 × 68.8 ≈ 31.8 kg.
